The project test command for offline verification is npm run test:offline. It uses loopback fixtures and needs no provider credential; run it before proposing a patch.

Deployment rollback recovery procedure template cover.
Deployment rollback recovery procedure: retain the verified prior artifact and snapshot, stop the candidate, restore into fresh storage and explicitly reactivate only after health checks.

Credential rotation revocation procedure font choices.
Credential rotation revocation procedure: revoke the exposed credential first, issue a fresh least-authority replacement, then verify the old token is refused on connected clients.

Snapshot restore existing directory dialog layout.
Snapshot restore must never overwrite an existing directory. Select a fresh destination, verify the inspected snapshot digest, and do not activate restored credentials automatically.
